description: Message signing vectors from the Electrum test suite, and its verification cases.

vectors.name: electrum/test_signmessage_legacy_address
vectors.message: Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks
vectors.comment: The uncompressed-key vector of this test is not included: hw only uses compressed keys. Electrum grinds the nonce until r < 2^255 (low R, as Bitcoin Core does for transaction signatures) while hw, like Bitcoin Core's SignCompact, uses plain RFC6979. For this message the RFC6979 signature has r >= 2^255, so Electrum's signature is different but equally valid: it is verified against hw's message hash and key.

vectors.name: electrum/test_signmessage_low_s/high-s
vectors.message: Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks
vectors.comment: Valid signature with a high S value (s > n/2). Bitcoin Core's verifymessage does not enforce low S, so it is accepted. hw never produces high-S signatures (libsecp256k1 normalizes S). Same key and message as the test_signmessage_legacy_address vector.

vectors.name: electrum/test_signmessage_segwit_witness_v0_address
vectors.comment: Electrum signs for SegWit addresses using the plain compressed-key header (31/32), so the signature equals the P2PKH signature of the same key. The P2PKH address is not from the source: it was derived from the key.

verification.name: electrum/verify/uncompressed
verification.comment: The uncompressed key of the test (WIF 5Hxn5C4SQuiV6e62A1MtZmbSeQyrLFhu5uYks62pU5VBUygK2KD): header byte 28.

verification.name: electrum/verify/other-key
verification.message: Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks
verification.comment: The signature of the uncompressed key, of another message, checked against the address of the compressed key.

verification.name: electrum/verify/not-a-signature
verification.message: Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks
verification.comment: The bytes "wrong" as a signature, in base64: 5 bytes, not 65.

verification.name: electrum/verify/p2sh-p2wpkh
verification.comment: Electrum signs for its SegWit addresses with the plain compressed-key header byte and verifies them. The format does not sign from a P2SH address: hw refuses the address.

verification.name: electrum/verify/p2wpkh
verification.comment: The same signature for the P2WPKH address of the key: hw refuses the address.

verification.name: electrum/verify/trezor-p2sh-p2wpkh
verification.message: This is an example of a signed message.
verification.comment: A Trezor signature with the BIP-137 header byte 35, for P2SH-P2WPKH, which Electrum accepts: hw refuses the address.

verification.name: electrum/verify/trezor-p2wpkh
verification.message: This is an example of a signed message.
verification.comment: A Trezor signature with the BIP-137 header byte 40, for P2WPKH: hw refuses the address.
